producer: webpack --mode production --config-name webviews:common --config-name webviews --env analyzeBundle --env quick
budgetRationale: The full GitLens profile has a 12 KiB ceiling above main for host-neutral extension seams. shared.js (loaded by every webview) gets a 4 KiB ceiling so unrelated shared-code changes don't trip a graph check while real bloat still does. graph.css allows two accounted moves: the element rename (gl-lit-graph to gl-commit-graph adds three bytes to every prefixed rule) and the VS Code theme-token table, which now ships in the package's themes/vscode.css instead of being written from JavaScript (a JS-to-CSS move, neutral for the entrypoint). Dropping the element prefix is queued and will take the ceiling back toward main.
